item.tib: dbal phur 'bar ba nag po'i 'phrin las me ri 'khyil pa rin chen gter mdzod kyi rgyud las gong gnon khyung gi zlog
item.coloph: stag rtse g.yung drung 'khyil pa'i spral sku g.yung drung bstan pa dbang rgyal gyis bskul ngor/ mkha' 'gro'i lung bzhin kong yul du stag ris can gyi (gyis) spel nas de nyid la babs pa'i dge des/ mnyam med 'gro ba'i mgon po'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
